title: Davriel Cane | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the Planeswalker Davriel Cane, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Davriel Cane is a simple man who enjoys simple pleasures: wealth, luxury, and fine tea. He also happens to be a talented diabolist, skilled at binding demons to his service. He detests playing the hero, yet often finds himself in the role despite his best efforts to avoid it.
